facts.fact: Punch reports that Nigeria introduced a Cloud First policy in 2019 to discourage ministries, departments and agencies from building separate data centres and to encourage use of cloud services.

Punch quotes NITDA Director-General Kashifu Inuwa saying the existing Cloud First policy remains in force and that government agencies are not prohibited from using international public cloud platforms; published 2026-08-12.

Punch reports, quoting Inuwa, that NITDA's consultation process has produced three guidelines covering data classification and cloud policy, minimum requirements for cloud service providers, and digital quality assurance; no date is given, so the published date 2026-08-12 is used.
